description: Convert the economizer control strategy for all middle-floor (M.*) packaged single-zone HVAC systems in the '4StoreyBuilding' project. Currently, these systems use dry-bulb temperature control. You must: 1) Change the 'OA-CONTROL' to 'ENTHALPY' for systems M.S21, M.E22, M.N23, M.W24, and M.C25. 2) Set the 'ENTHALPY-LIMIT' to 28 Btu/lb for these systems. 3) Run the annual energy simulation. 4) Save the project. No step-by-step UI instructions are provided; you must navigate the Air-Side HVAC module independently.
